title: G1: Prepare the disposable three-Action rehearsal fixture (no production change)
problem: The installed three-Action autonomous rehearsal needs a fresh disposable private GitHub repository with one CI check (arcadia qa pr refuses an empty statusCheckRollup) and one registered fixture Project with Plan autonomous-three-action-rehearsal and serial Actions write-start-marker, transform-start-marker and verify-final-rehearsal. The repository identifier is operator input; nothing may guess it.
desired_effect: Validate the one operator-supplied owner/name, prove it is safe to create or reuse, create the local fixture at ~/tmp/arcadia-three-action-rehearsal with only its genesis files and a single ubuntu-latest CI job, create or reuse the private GitHub repository and push only the genesis commit, register and sync the fixture Project, and seed only the first Action's build packet. Production policy is never previewed or activated.

parameters.ARCADIA_REHEARSAL_GITHUB_REPO: Required environment variable: the exact owner/name. The owner must be the authenticated gh user; the name must match ^arcadia-three-action-rehearsal(-[a-z0-9]{1,24})?$. Launched from /runs without it, the script refuses with a receipt and changes nothing.

does: Refuses before any other step unless ARCADIA_REHEARSAL_GITHUB_REPO is exactly owner/name, the owner is the authenticated gh user, and the name matches the disposable-fixture pattern
Requires the Arcadia checkout clean on main and production Inactive with a readable store
Reuses a repository only when it is private, not archived or a fork, and either empty or a repository this script created whose main is exactly the local fixture genesis; anything else refuses
Creates the repository private with a disposable-fixture description only when GitHub confirms it does not exist; an unknown GitHub answer refuses

Writes only AGENTS.md, CONSTITUTION.md, PROJECT.md, the fixture Plan, scripts/check-rehearsal.mjs, .github/workflows/ci.yml and the fixture manifest, then pushes only that genesis commit without force

Imports and syncs only Project three-action-rehearsal with Plan autonomous-three-action-rehearsal and Actions write-start-marker, transform-start-marker and verify-final-rehearsal, and seeds only write-start-marker's build packet for claude-code-cli
Writes a timestamped receipt under runs/<timestamp-pid>/ on success and refusal, plus a failure handoff on refusal
never_does: Never previews or activates production policy, presses the G7 Grant, or approves a packet
Never starts, stops or restarts a service or worker, and never launches a Session
Never deletes, renames, archives or changes the visibility of any repository, never force-pushes, and never adds branch protection, CodeRabbit or other integrations
Never reuses a public, foreign, non-empty or advanced repository, and never repoints an existing Project it did not register
Never guesses or defaults the repository identifier

success.effect: A private disposable repository holds exactly the fixture genesis with one CI workflow, and the fixture Project, Plan and three serial Actions are registered with the first packet seeded. Production is unchanged.
success.next: Run recover-arcadia-host-services so the reinstalled broker trusts the new fixture repository and the worker runs current code, then run the G6 preflight (preflight-three-action-rehearsal-2026-10-04).

failure.effect: The receipt and failure handoff name the failed precondition and whether this run created or pushed to the repository. Nothing was deleted or force-pushed and production was not touched.
failure.next: Correct the named precondition and rerun with the same identifier; a different identifier requires moving the old local fixture aside yourself first.
